summary: Evidence Action's Deworm the World supports government-run school-based deworming in India, Kenya, Nigeria and Pakistan. SoGive's deworming cost-effectiveness analysis (August 2022): GiveWell's 2022 model with SoGive's own, much lower, replicability adjustment for the long-term income gains of deworming. Every number is traced from the sheet's bottom line for Deworm the World; calculated rows reproduce the sheet's own values.

With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).

SoGive's units of value are GiveWell's: one unit is doubling one person's consumption for a year.
